prompt: How many countries were not listed as offering only paid access to YouTube Music at the time of its initial expansion in 2018?
answer: **17 countries.** In the 2018 expansion, YouTube Music was offered in the original five countries plus 12 new ones, and it included a free, ad-supported option alongside the paid tier—not paid access only.
